prompt:
ContextCartographer: Update organizational context — Factor: New competitor entered Latin American market with ISO-certified products, Type: External-Competitive, Impact: High, Affected Standards: ISO 9001, Response Needed: Accelerate certification timeline for Mexico plant

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- contextId (string): unique identifier for the context entry
- factor (string): the contextual factor identified
- type (string): type/category of the record
- impactLevel (string): level of impact (high, medium, low)
- affectedStandards (string): ISO standards affected by this factor
- responseAction (string): action to be taken in response
- identifiedDate (string): date when the factor was identified
- reviewStatus (string): current review status

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
